title: Photos
description: Photo library (capability photos, build 8 adds video). All photo operations ride POST /photos with envelope gating protocol_v->min_peer_build->capability->token->payload. Chunks reuse 1 MiB raw max (~1.4 MiB b64) to stay under MaxBodyBytes 8 MiB. Photo IDs are opaque MediaStore row IDs: legacy pure digits = image, or namespaced img:<row> / vid:<row> (1..128, no slash). Listing is cursor-paged (date_taken DESC, _id DESC, images+video merged) with limit 1..200 (default 100). Entries carry media_type photo|video (absent = photo) and duration_ms for video. Thumbs are fetched separately via photo-thumb-req/resp (video thumbs are JPEG frame grabs). Full-res is streamed via photo-chunk (transfer_id+absolute offset idempotent, sha256 on full-file last chunk); photo-pull-req accepts optional offset/length for range streaming (0 = legacy full pull) and range chunks reuse absolute chunk_index/total_chunks so each chunk validates standalone. Permission errors carry error_code=permission_denied + permission=photos so Mac can render separate empty-states for files vs photos; decoders ignore unknown fields.

nonce.description: Random per-message value the ack must echo.

req_id.description: Correlation id for req/resp pairs (photo-list, thumb-req, delete).

cursor.description: Opaque paging cursor (empty = first page). Sort is date_taken DESC, _id DESC.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for next page (empty = no more pages).

photo_id.description: Opaque MediaStore row ID: pure digits (legacy image) or img:<row> / vid:<row>. Never a filesystem path.

media_type.description: Entry kind. Absent on the wire means photo (pre-0.8.0 peers).

duration_ms.description: Video duration in millis (MediaStore DURATION). 0 = unknown/live. Photos omit it.

length.description: Range length for photo-pull-req in bytes (0 = full pull, legacy). Range chunks reuse absolute photo-chunk offsets.

taken_at.description: Unix millis when photo was taken (MediaStore DATE_TAKEN or DATE_MODIFIED fallback).

thumb_size.description: Requested thumb long edge in px (64..1024). Server clamps and returns actual size in entry.

mime.description: MIME of thumb (always image/jpeg) or full-res (image/jpeg, image/heic, video/mp4, video/quicktime, video/3gpp...).

data_b64.description: Base64 thumb bytes (max ~1.4 MiB) or photo-chunk bytes (1 MiB raw cap). Empty only for zero-byte edge.

error.description: Human error for resp (e.g. permission prompt).

error_code.description: Machine error_code: permission_denied, not_found, invalid_arg, internal. Separate from human error.

permission.description: Which permission domain failed: photos or files. Lets Mac render separate empty-states.

transfer_id.description: Hex id for chunked photo transfer (16-64 hex chars, crypto/rand).

offset.description: Absolute byte offset of this chunk (photo-pull-req offset for range pulls, 0 for full pulls).

sha256.description: Optional hex sha256 of full file (last chunk only).

results.description: Per-item delete results for photo-delete-resp (partial success is normal).
